prompt: What would be the most sensible first step to make the cards easier to read at the next supper?
promptZh: 下次聚餐時，若想讓菜名卡更容易閱讀，先採取哪個做法最合理？

options.text: Move the screen against the wall before asking for any more electrical work.
options.zh: 先把屏風移到牆邊，再考慮是否需要請電工處理。
options.whyZh: 只開天花板的燈時，兩桌的菜名卡原本都清楚；問題是挪動屏風後才出現，開關沒人動。簡報說屏風放在兩桌之間會遮住照向菜名卡的燈光，靠牆的燈則照不到菜名卡。先把屏風移到牆邊、看看照明是否恢復，比直接請電工處理合理。

options.text: Leave the screen between the tables and ask the crew to replace the older wall lights.
options.zh: 把屏風留在兩張餐檯之間，請電工班更換沿牆的舊燈。
options.whyZh: 沿牆的燈照不到菜名卡，換燈並未處理屏風擋住原本光線的問題。

options.text: Leave the screen between the tables and ask the crew to check whether a new ceiling light has failed.
options.zh: 把屏風留在兩張餐檯之間，請電工班檢查是否有一盞新裝的天花板燈故障。
options.whyZh: 原本只開天花板的燈就看得清楚；挪動屏風後才看不清楚。先排除簡報指出的遮光問題，比先懷疑燈故障更合理。

options.text: Move the screen against the wall and ask the crew to change the wall lights at the same time.
options.zh: 把屏風移到牆邊，同時請電工班更換沿牆的燈。
options.whyZh: 把屏風移開是合理的第一步，但沿牆的燈照不到菜名卡，沒有理由同時更換。

explanationZh: 只開天花板的燈時，兩桌的菜名卡原本都清楚；問題是挪動屏風後才出現，開關沒人動。簡報說屏風放在兩桌之間會遮住照向菜名卡的燈光，靠牆的燈則照不到菜名卡。先把屏風移到牆邊、看看照明是否恢復，比直接請電工處理合理。
evidence: The electrical crew replaced the lights above the serving tables, not the ones along the wall. The portable screen can stand either along the wall or between the two serving tables. From its place between the tables it cuts off the light from the ceiling fitting above the far table before that light reaches the name cards on the near table. The wall lights do not shine onto the cards from either position. / in the test run we could read the name cards at both tables with just the ceiling lights on. / Nobody touched the switches, but I could no longer read the cards at the near table. / I’d rather not ask the electrical crew back unless we really need them.

vocabulary.note: 這裡指屏風遮斷光線的路徑，不是切斷供電或關燈。
